rule_text.name: 702.284a
rule_text.rule: Deploy is a static ability. “Deploy N” means “As this permanent enters, you may tap any number of other untapped creatures you control with total power N or more. If you do, this permanent is deployed.” Tapping the creatures is a cost (see rule 118) and may be referred to as paying the permanent's deploy cost.

rule_text.name: 702.284b
rule_text.rule: Deployed is a designation that has no rules meaning other than to act as a marker that spells and abilities can identify. Only permanents can be or become deployed. Once a permanent becomes deployed, it stays deployed until it leaves the battlefield. Deployed is neither an ability nor part of the permanent's copiable values.

rule_text.name: 702.284c
rule_text.rule: A permanent “enters deployed” as it enters the battlefield if its deploy cost was paid.
